## Automated Tests Required

### Stories `12-1`, `12-2`, `12-3`: In-Game Public & Whisper Chat — UI / Integration / Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/ChatSystemTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- `CanvasGroup` visibility state machine (`Active=1.0`, `Passive=0.65`, `Fade=0.35`) keeping `gameObject.activeSelf == true` and toggling `InputFocusFlag.ChatFocused`.
- `/w <TargetName> <Body>` parser, `<`/`>` rich-text tag sanitization, `120`-char clamping, self/unknown whisper rejection, and `[RpcTarget]` target resolution.
- Token-Bucket rate limiter (`5.0` tokens per `3.0s`) and `50`-row `ChatMessageRow` ring buffer recycling (`0` `Instantiate`/`Destroy` on message `51+`).
**Estimated test count**: ~9 unit/integration tests

### Stories `13-1`, `13-2`, `13-3`: PlayFab Cloud Identity, Stats & Leaderboard — Integration / Logic / UI
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/PlayFabServiceTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- `LoginWithCustomID` persistence (`playfab_identity.json`), exponential backoff (`1s, 2s, 4s`), and non-blocking `OfflineGuest` transition when offline or unconfigured.
- `SubmitMatchResultAsync` idempotency (`_lastSubmittedMatchId`), kill clamping (`[0, 15]`), and 1-slot `pendingSubmission` offline retry queue.
- `GetLeaderboard` `15.0s` cache TTL and `20` pre-warmed `LeaderboardRowView` items.
**Estimated test count**: ~9 unit/integration tests

### Stories `14-1`, `14-2`, `14-3`: 3D Spatial Audio, URP VFX Pool & Hit-Flash/Squash — Integration / Visual/Feel
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/AudioVfxPoolTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- `SoundManager` `16`-emitter 3D pool (`spatialBlend=1.0`, `min=2.5m`, `max=28.0m`, `30.0m` culling, oldest-voice stealing on `17th` concurrent sound).
- `VfxManager` `20`-instance pool (`StopEmittingAndClear` on acquire/release, `0` runtime `Instantiate`/`Destroy`).
- `CapsuleVisualFeedback` `MaterialPropertyBlock` Hit-Flash (`sharedMaterial` reference unchanged across 50 rapid hits) and `DOKill(true)` Squash & Stretch resetting `VisualRoot.localScale == Vector3.one`.
**Estimated test count**: ~8 unit/integration tests

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Verify Public Chat broadcast, Private Whisper (`/w <PlayerName> <Msg>`) isolation to sender/recipient only, and `5 msgs / 3.0s` rate limiting.
2. Verify PlayFab login (and `OfflineGuest` fallback when offline), end-of-match stats submission (`TotalWins`, `TotalKills`, `MatchesPlayed`), and Top 20 Leaderboard Modal rendering.
3. Verify 3D spatial audio attenuation (`2.5m..28.0m`), pooled URP slash arcs (`50 deg` vertical / `90 deg` horizontal), and `MaterialPropertyBlock` Hit-Flash + Squash & Stretch at `>= 60 FPS` with `0` runtime `Instantiate`/`Destroy`.
